data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A test constrains its subject only if the test's own failure is a necessary condition for the subject's installation; the 1/9 mutations lost under shown-to-fail-first installation are lost because the guard that would catch them never fires on its own author's mutation.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the guard fires on its own author's mutation and the mutation is still lost, the constraint is not from the guard's blindness.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 1/9 loss rate is independent of whether the mutation is in the author's module, the constraint is not author-specific.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the mutation is lost even when the guard is not installed, the test describes rather than constrains.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The guard that checks declared data does not see added behavior, so when the mutation is in the author's own module, the guard's failure to fire becomes a precondition for the mutation to be installed as a test subject. The test constrains the subject by excluding exactly the mutations that would expose the guard's blindness.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
